$comment: Text that keeps upstream's name in the shipped image. A string or line containing any of these is left as written. Add an entry only with the reason. The runtime-context header and event markers are NOT exempt: they are injected into every model turn, so they must say the product name; the emitter and the matcher are both string literals and are rewritten together. Transcripts written before the rename keep the old header, which the matcher no longer recognises; that only affects how those old lines are tidied on screen.
